# Shopify listing — copy & paste

**Title:** The Skinny Laws Vault — 120 Hacks to Get Lean & Stay Lean

**Suggested price:** $19 (launch price $14 for the first week using a discount code, e.g. `VAULT5`)

**Description:**

Not a diet. Not a meal plan you'll quit by Thursday. The Skinny Laws Vault is 120 unusual, science-backed hacks that make being lean feel easy and normal — without starving.

**What's inside**
- 🔐 **12 Laws, 120 hacks**: Hunger, Kitchen, Cravings, Movement, Sleep & Stress, Eating Out, Grocery & Prep, Drinks, Mindset, De-Bloat, Shape, and Stay-Lean-Forever
- Every hack explains **what to do, why it works, and exactly how**, step by step
- 🧠 **60-second eating-type quiz**: find out if you're a Grazer, Stress Eater, Night Nibbler or Weekend Rebounder, and which Laws to start with
- 📅 **30-Day Skinny Laws Challenge**: one tiny action a day
- 🛒 **Lean Grocery List** (tick-box)
- 🍽️ **Restaurant Cheat Sheet**: what to order at 8 kinds of places
- 📉 **Weekly Average Tracker**: stop panicking at the scale
- ✍️ Journal prompts, myth-busters and "try this tonight" challenges for every Law

**Interactive & phone-friendly.** Tap the menu to jump to any section, search all 120 hacks, tick off the ones you've tried, and save your favorites. Also included as a clickable PDF.

**Instant download.** Right after you buy, you get an email with your download link.

*This guide is general education for healthy adults. It is not medical advice. It promotes sustainable habits only: no crash diets, pills or detox teas.*
